name: Twelve Permissions #04 — THE BOOK
description: TO PUBLISH, EVEN FROM BEHIND A CURTAIN. We wrote a book. Amazon published it. The Hockey IQ Workbook: sixty game-situation decision drills, for youth players and the parents and coaches trying to teach them. My name is not on it. There is personal material in there, the kind you do not notice is personal until it is typeset, and when it came time to put an author on the cover I chose one that was not me. It went out under The Prepared Nest. Built it in the open, then hid behind a pen name to release it. Both true. Evidence: The Hockey IQ Workbook, published through Kindle Direct Publishing as The Prepared Nest, 14 July 2026.
